native_notes.claude-code: User CLAUDE.md and rules are loaded by Claude Code. Native exclusions or managed-only settings can suppress them. Existing conditional rules retain their original conditions.

native_notes.codex: In the current local CODEX_HOME, a non-empty AGENTS.override.md takes precedence over AGENTS.md. Changes apply to new runs. A desktop or remote backend may use a different home. The default 32 KiB instruction budget is shared with project guidance and can be configured natively.

native_notes.pi: Context candidates use their native priority. SYSTEM.md replaces the system prompt; APPEND_SYSTEM.md appends to it. Native flags or project files may change loading. Use /reload or a new session.

native_notes.step-code: These paths belong to the Step entry point. Its native context priority is preserved. SYSTEM.md and APPEND_SYSTEM.md have different roles; project files can override them.

native_notes.amp: These are verified local user-level candidates. Native settings, profile, backend and project context may affect loading. Arca edits the original files without changing their native activation or priority.

native_notes.gemini: Uses the configured context.fileName when available. Gemini loads and combines its native context sources; imports and reload behavior remain native. Use /memory reload or a new session.

native_notes.qwen-code: QWEN_HOME and context.fileName may change the path. Rules with paths frontmatter are conditional; baseline rules and QWEN.md have different native loading behavior.

native_notes.qoder-cli: QODER_CONFIG_DIR and context.fileName may change the path. This is the local CLI contract, not the IDE rules system. Use the native memory reload or a new session.

native_notes.codebuddy-code: The user CODEBUDDY.md and rules are native sources. WorkBuddy China uses this contract in code-development mode. Auto memory is separate; conditional rules keep their original conditions.
